name: legalkart-docs-tools
description: Builds the PDFs in ../pdf from the Markdown docs.

scripts.pdf: node md-to-pdf.mjs ../docs/USER-GUIDE.md ../pdf/LegalKart-User-Guide.pdf "Step-by-step guide to making a stamped rent agreement: tenant OTP verification, payment, e-stamp, printing and signing, troubleshooting and FAQ." && node md-to-pdf.mjs ../docs/MARKETING-PLAN.md ../pdf/LegalKart-Marketing-Plan.pdf "Positioning, audiences, 90-day launch plan, channels, ready-to-use copy, KPIs and marketing compliance checklist." && node md-to-pdf.mjs ../SPEC.md ../pdf/LegalKart-Product-Technical-Spec.pdf "Product and technical specification: tech stack, database schema, integration flows, template JSON Schema, build plan and sample code."
